mcqs.question: The Aranmula Uthrattathi boat race is associated with which GI-tagged heritage product of Aranmula?
mcqs.explanation: Aranmula Kannadi is the GI-tagged metal mirror associated with Aranmula. Palliyodams are snake boats used in the race, while the Parthasarathy Temple and Pampa River are associated with the event but are not GI-tagged products.
